newsitem.title: UK: Ex-FSU oil exports fell 200,000 bpd in August - IEA.
newsitem.headline: Ex-FSU oil exports fell 200,000 bpd in August - IEA.

text.p: Oil exports from the countries of the former Soviet Union fell 200,000 barrels per day (bpd) in August to 2.8 million bpd, due to a sharp decline in gas oil shipments, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said on Friday.
Gas oil exports through Baltic ports fell by 170,000 bpd from July, the IEA said in its latest monthly oil market report.
The decline was "similar to the seasonal pattern seen last year," the IEA added.
Despite August's lower tally, the Paris-based OECD energy watchdog still expects exports from the former Soviet Union to average 2.52 million bpd in 1996, up 130,000 bpd from 1995.
Estimates for Russian production in July and August were left unchanged at 6.04 and 6.07 million bpd respectively.

Production in Kazakhstan in July averaged just under 450,000 bpd, an increase of about 10,000 bpd from June largely because of rises in output in the Precaspian Basin fields and the Mangyshlak-Buzachi Peninsula.
Azerbaijan saw output ease in July to 187,000 bpd, the IEA said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7930
